messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert - HIGH latency spike on routing-service in eu-west-1. Affected: hosted-api, traffic tier: standard. Auto-attach: runbook-routing-v2 https://internal/runbooks/rr-v2 :rotating_light:

emma: ack oncall — jumping in. pulling logs. ETA 5m

emma: tl;dr: spikes started ~1813008000, error rate for /v1/generate up 12% for std tier, latency p95 jumped to 3.2s. No infra termination events yet.

raj: i'm joining, can you paste the route decision logs from the router? suspect spillover to reserve pool.

emma: dumping last 200 lines from route-router (eu-west-1):
```
[1813008023] route-decision id=abc123 req_tier=standard selected_target=d-model-quant v=1.3 score=0.71
[1813008030] route-decision id=abc456 req_tier=premium selected_target=p-model v=2.0 score=0.95
[1813008038] route-decision id=abc789 req_tier=standard selected_target=fallback-large v=1.1 score=0.66
[1813008052] warn route-mismatch id=abc111 intended_tier=standard actual_target=p-model reason=policy-fallback
```

marta: interesting — looks like some standard-tier requests are being routed to premium models (p-model) as fallback. could be policy mis-eval or version mismatch.

ben: adding hypothesis list (H):
H1: routing-policy evaluation bug caused misroute of standard -> premium under load (score threshold miscalculated)
H2: capacity shortage in eu-west-1 premium pool triggered fallback that incorrectly matched tier labels
H3: telemetry/reporting lag — UI shows standard but request metadata tagged premium upstream

lia: quick customer-impact note: CS reports 3 customers in EU saw degraded latency and token cost spike. Open case ID CS-4642. Notify accounts: @customer-success

customer-success: alerted CS leads, prepping customer timeline. asking if we have mitigation for in-flight requests.

emma: mitigation applied: set temporary hard-routing override in eu-west-1 to prevent standard -> premium fallback. command:
```
# temporary block fallback
curl -X POST https://config-api/override -d '{"scope":"eu-west-1","rule":"no-tier-upgrade","enabled":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
```

ops-bot: config change accepted. new policy id=ov-20260315-eu no-tier-upgrade active

raj: confirming: after override p95 dropped to 1.1s in eu-west-1 for standard. can we capture before/after metrics? need numbers for RCA.

emma: attaching quick metrics snapshot (tokens/sec, p95, errors):
- before: p95=3.2s, errors=12.1%, tokens/s=420k
- after: p95=1.15s, errors=1.9%, tokens/s=410k

marta: ok that's compelling evidence for H1/H2 still possible. logs show a specific code path where `policy-evaluator` used wrong threshold for `score` when `fallback_enabled=true`.

ben: paste from policy-evaluator trace:
```
[policy-evaluator] req=abc111 tier=standard fallback_enabled=true threshold=0.7 score=0.66 => fallthrough->select premium
# expected: if score < threshold and reserve pool available => select same-tier reserve. current behavior: select any compatible variant.
```

raj: flagged as severity-high. I'll own a short RCA draft. Open checklist: timeline, evidence, customer impact, root cause, and remediation.

lia: customer note for CS: we should offer credits for impacted customers; tally usage delta and estimated billing impact. adding to CS-4642.

emma: handoff to raj for postmortem write-up. @raj you're on for next 4h — lia/ben please support with logs/metrics.

raj: taking. I'll create timeline in the wiki and link. preliminary timeline:
- 1813008000: routing-service latency begins to climb
- 1813008023: first observed misroute entry in route-router
- 1813008052: policy-evaluator fallthrough warning
- 1813008120: incident-bot pages oncall
- 1813008200: temporary no-tier-upgrade override applied
- 1813008300: p95 returns to baseline

marta: also note: eu-west-1 reserve pool reached 85% at 1813007990 — include in timeline

ben: collecting logs for RCA. linking log bundle: https://logs.internal/archives/1813008674-routing-bundle

emma: small follow-up: we saw one request with `client_metadata.tier` missing that could have triggered defaulting logic. adding to H3.

raj: plan for remediation (short):
- fix policy-evaluator threshold logic and add unit tests (owner: eng-runtime)
- enforce strict tier matching in fallback (owner: eng-platform)
- improve telemetry to show original client tier and final target in same trace (owner: eng-infra)
- add alert when reserve pool >80% for 5m (owner: eng-sre)

lia: schedule postmortem write and customer comms sync at 11:30 PT. I'll draft a customer-friendly timeline.

customer-success: noted. please cc CS-ops when RCA is ready.

raj: thanks all — will produce RCA draft by EOD. leaving the thread here for evidence aggregation. :white_check_mark:
